name: smwblocks-throw-blocks-pack
title: Throw Blocks Pack
description:
This block pack contains 5 blocks:

-a block, when pressing dash, will spawn a throw block while the block itself still there (unlike smw). Its called "infinite_throwblk.asm". When using this, you can forget about using reset doors, since it reduces "stuck problems".

-a "brick" that can only be shattered by throw blocks, and if mario *KICKS* it into them will pierce through them. Its called "shatter_throwblk.asm".

-a bumper that bounces the throw block without shattering it.

-a solid block that only allows a throw block to pass

-and a "Stopper & preserver" that traps the throw block on contact and keeps its "dissipates" timer at #$FF

This is useful for puzzles.

Have fun.
